item.title: China's Moonshot AI claims Kimi K3 can rival OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description:
China’s Moonshot AI Takes a Giant Leap Forward

In a stunning display of technological prowess, Chinese AI start-up Moonshot has unveiled its latest creation: Kimi K3, a massive artificial intelligence model that reportedly rivals top American firms. The company’s claim is nothing short of extraordinary, with Kimi K3 boasting an impressive 2.8 trillion parameters – a measure of an AI’s scale and processing power that puts it in a league with the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic.
